tailored:
Dear Lucid Labs team,

What draws me to this role is the middle part most people skip: deciding what "good" means before building, then proving the system reaches it. That matches how I already work — in my TalentHiv project I built an AI-driven CV screening system with FastAPI and PostgreSQL, ran validation, error handling and testing with Pytest, and deployed it on Azure App Service with Key Vault rather than leaving it as a local demo.

I also built VoiceHive Hotels, a multilingual AI voice assistant with real-time speech handling, GPT-4 via Azure OpenAI, and a Docker/Kubernetes architecture designed for cost-effective scaling. Between these projects I have hands-on experience with prompt design, structured outputs, RAG, LangChain, and the production frontends this role asks for — I built TalentHiv's interface in Next.js, React and TypeScript, including GDPR features and proper error handling.

Before retraining as a developer, I spent twenty years leading operational teams of 50+ in a strictly regulated environment at Svenska Spel, which is where I learned structured written status, incident handling, and explaining technical matters so non-experts can decide. I write state down so nobody has to chase me.

I am based in Malmö and am looking for a remote role. I would welcome the chance to talk.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
